brief:
Rescue operations at a Gaza residence known as the "al-Suafiri" house concluded after workers extracted 11 bodies from the site, Maan Wire reported. The recovery effort involved the systematic removal of remains from the single residential structure located in the territory.

The operation marks the completion of search and retrieval efforts at the location. Authorities did not immediately provide details about the circumstances that led to the deaths or the full timeline of the multi-stage rescue work at the house.
title: Rescue workers recover 11 bodies from Gaza residence
